articles.summary: Founded in 2006 by Maya Elisabeth, OM is a female-owned cannabis wellness brand rooted in California’s medical era and still guided by whole-plant integrity today. Long before bath soaks and intimate topicals were mainstream, OM was formulating with cannabis and complementary botanicals to support real, everyday needs. With nearly two decades of consistency behind staples like Lion Balm and infused Epsom Salts, OM continues to bridge legacy and modern cannabis—now expanding into craft flower while staying true to its founding principles.
articles.title: OM: A Female-Owned Cannabis Wellness Brand Redefining Ritual Since 2006

articles.summary: Moon Made Farms is a female-owned regenerative sungrown cannabis farm located in Humboldt County’s Emerald Triangle. Founded by Tina Gordon, the Garberville-based farm cultivates small-batch organic cannabis using living soil, regenerative farming practices, and lunar cultivation principles. From award-winning genetics to its signature Queen Cola releases, Moon Made Farms represents the evolving future of California-sungrown cannabis.
articles.title: Inside Moon Made Farms: Regenerative Sungrown Cannabis from Humboldt’s Emerald Triangle
